title: Anatomy of a 2-3 sigma Hint: An Independent Stress Test of the DESI DR2 Evolving-Dark-Energy Preference
description: Independent reimplementation and adversarial stress test of the compressed likelihoods behind the DESI DR2 preference for evolving dark energy. Reproduces the published results (Delta-chi2 ladder, posteriors, DIC), then maps the preference's fragility: leave-one-out influence diagnostics, an eBOSS comparator swap, calibration intercept tests, w(z) parameterization swaps, a 5,000-mock significance calibration, a full-CMB lensing variant (finding the preference falls to ~1.4 sigma without the single LRG2 measurement), and a pre-registered cross-probe hypothesis chain in which one kill condition was met (the supernova crossing feature is degenerate with a low-z calibration offset). AI-assisted implementation; four external adversarial reviews adopted; all data public and primary-sourced; publish-regardless protocol.
